title: deploy/ folder: what is installed where
caption: deploy/README.md 'How the files map to the VM'. Templates in the repository; root-owned copies on the VM; env files written once by provision-vm.sh.

nodes.label: scripts/*.sh
nodes.detail: deploy, backup, restore, alert, run-as, healthcheck, ship-logs, log-review, egress, provision-vm, check-vm, pack-release, dev-setup.

nodes.label: caddy/Caddyfile + waf/*.conf
nodes.detail: Hosts, headers, log filters, WAF snippets; `coraza.conf`, `exclusions.conf`, generated `logdata.conf`.

nodes.label: caddy/build/build-caddy.sh, versions.env
nodes.detail: Reproducible xcaddy build; fails unless SHA-256 = `CADDY_SHA256`.

nodes.label: env/*.env.example
nodes.detail: One template per app; `@@...@@` generated, `CHANGE_ME` filled by hand.

nodes.label: postgres/bootstrap.sql, velexis.conf
nodes.detail: Database, four roles, schemas `platform` and `reference`, default privileges; tuning for 8 GB.

nodes.label: egress/allowed-hosts.conf
nodes.detail: One host, port, protocol, user and reason per line.

nodes.label: /usr/local/sbin/velexis-*
nodes.detail: Root-owned copies, re-installed by every deploy (egress only by `--steps egress`).

nodes.label: /etc/caddy/Caddyfile, /etc/caddy/waf/
nodes.detail: Validated with `caddy validate` before replacing the live files.

nodes.label: /etc/velexis/*.env, keys/
nodes.detail: `root:root 0600`, read by systemd only; key folders 0500 per zone.

nodes.label: nftables inet velexis_egress
nodes.detail: Policy drop on output; refreshed every 2 minutes.

nodes.label: ci.yml deploy-files, systemd-units, check-vm
nodes.detail: shellcheck, Caddy build + smoke, deploy/healthcheck/ship-logs/log-review tests, units smoke, check-vm test.
